name: resample
description: Live resampling: the Sample Recorder records into the sample bank's free space; Tracker Audio and Record Tracker in the setup's slots 2 and 3 let the pattern be heard (Play, Shift+Rec, Play during a recording) and recorded with Line In

branches.note: record start 0x600f9074: bl 0x6010cb90(rec, 0x8026a000, 0x3c00000, ch, ch, flag) -> mt_rs_rec_buffer (the buffer moved above the loaded samples)
record start 0x600f9074: bl 0x6010c890(rec), the record queues' start (from Rec and from the count-in's end) -> mt_rs_rec_started (Shift+Rec: open the gates, play the pattern)
bl 0x600fbc40(scr), the setup's slot 2-4 labels for every source but Radio -> mt_rs_labels1 (draws Tracker Audio and Record Tracker after it)
bl 0x600fbc40(scr), the setup's slot 2-4 labels for every source but Radio -> mt_rs_labels2 (draws Tracker Audio and Record Tracker after it)
bl 0x600fbc40(scr), the setup's slot 2-4 labels for every source but Radio -> mt_rs_labels3 (draws Tracker Audio and Record Tracker after it)
bl 0x600fbc40(scr), the setup's slot 2-4 labels for every source but Radio -> mt_rs_labels4 (draws Tracker Audio and Record Tracker after it)
the record copy loop (audio interrupt): bl 0x6010c7c8(dst, src, 0x100), one input block into the recording -> mt_rs_copy (with Record Tracker: adds the master's matching block)
save request 0x60114e34, Save As only: bl strncpy(fm+0x340, name, 0x21) -> mt_rs_save_name (Tracker Audio and Record Tracker go with the project to its new name)

words.note: the recorder's button binder's pool word for the Rec handler 0x600d0621 -> mt_rs_rec_button (Shift held: arm the pattern start)
the recorder start's pool word for the Play button handler 0x600d07b5 -> mt_rs_play_button (opens the gates first during a moved recording)
Sample Recorder vtable, update 0x600fafe9 -> mt_rs_update (closes the gates once the recording has stopped)

ITCM image (copied to ITCM 0x1f544 at boot): the literal of the thunk 0x1f540 that engine_block_update (0x41d8) asks, rec+0x2c 0x6010c889 -> mt_rs_is_recording (no early return while the gates are open)
the setup's button binder 0x600f8db4: pool word for slot 2's press handler 0x600f86ad (Radio only in the setup) -> mt_rs_slot2_button (Tracker Audio)
the setup's button binder 0x600f8db4: pool word for slot 3's press handler 0x600f8a4d (Radio only in the setup) -> mt_rs_slot3_button (Record Tracker)
Sample Recorder vtable, start 0x600fa229 -> mt_rs_start (a new visit starts with the gates shut)
Pattern screen vtable: update method 0x600e1f99 -> mt_rs_pattern_update (resample.bin load/save)
project screen vtable: update method 0x600ead59 -> mt_rs_project_update (resample.bin: a new project seen before its first save)
the recorder start's pool word for the count-in's end callback 0x600f8605 (seq+0x6fc) -> mt_rs_countin_done (Record Tracker: mutes the last click)
